## Load libraries and dataset

```{r message=F, warning=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
animals <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/srajabia/DATA205-Final-Project/refs/heads/main/data/processed/animals.csv")
```

```{r}
head(animals)
```

## Recidivism

```{r}
dupe_ids <- animals |>
  group_by(animal_identification_number) |>
  summarise(count = n()) |>
  filter(count > 1)

animal_dupes <- animals |>
  filter(animal_identification_number %in% dupe_ids$animal_identification_number) 
```

```{r}
adopted <- animals |>
  filter(outcome_type == "ADOPTION" | outcome_type == "EUTH") |>
  group_by(animal_type) |>
  summarise(count = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))
adopted
```

## EDA #1: Animal types

```{r}
animalsYearEnd <- animals |>
  filter(intake_date_and_time <= as.Date("2026-01-02"))
```

```{r}
counts <- animalsYearEnd |>
  mutate(animal_type = if_else(animal_type %in% c("BIRD", "LIVESTOCK"), "OTHER", animal_type),
         intake_type = if_else(intake_type %in% c("BOARDING", "VETERINARY", "TRANSFER", "RETURN"), "OTHER", intake_type)) |>
  group_by(animal_type, intake_type) |>
  summarise(count = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(count))
counts <- counts |>
  mutate(percentage = round((count / sum(counts$count))*100, digits = 2))
counts
```

Most common intakes are stray dogs and cats, followed by surrendered cats and dogs.

```{r}
ggplot(counts, aes(x=fct_reorder(animal_type, count, .desc = T), y=count, fill = fct_reorder(intake_type, count))) + 
  geom_col() + 
  labs(
    title = "Shelter Intake Counts by Animal Type (2017-2026)",
    x= "Animal Type",
    y= "Count", 
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Intake Type", palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Distribution of length of stay

```{r}
animals |>
  filter(!is.na(stay_in_days) & stay_in_days > 0 & outcome_type == "ADOPTION") |>
  filter(animal_type == "CAT" | animal_type == "DOG") |>
  group_by(animal_type) |>
  summarise(count = n(),
            mean_stay_days = mean(stay_in_days)) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_stay_days))
```

```{r}
animals_box <- animalsYearEnd |>
  filter(animal_type == "DOG" | animal_type == "CAT") |>
  filter(outcome_type == "ADOPTION") |>
  filter(!is.na(animal_size)) |>
  filter(stay_in_days > 0)

ggplot(animals_box, aes(x=animal_type, y=stay_in_days, fill = fct_reorder(animal_size, stay_in_days))) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(2, 150)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Stay Duration in Days by Animal Type and Size (2017-2026)",
    x = " ",
    y = "Days in Shelter (Log Scale)",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center",
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Size", palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 120)
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
    legend.position = "top", 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

Larger animals have a higher median adoption time.

heatmap of color/ adopt time

```{r message=F}
animals_heatmap <- animals_box |>
  group_by(animal_type, primary_color, multicolored) |>
  summarise(mean_los = mean(stay_in_days),
            count = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(primary_color = fct_relevel(as.character(primary_color), "OTHER"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(animals_heatmap, aes(animal_type, primary_color, fill = mean_los)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black",linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ multicolored,
             labeller = as_labeller(c("TRUE" = "Multicolored", "FALSE" = "Single-colored"))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Mean Stay (Days)",
    option = "rocket",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Length of Stay by Animal Type and Primary Color",
    x = "",
    y = "Animal Color",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

scatterplot of age/adoption time.

```{r message=F, warning=F}
ggplot(animals_box, aes(age_days, stay_in_days, colour = animal_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_brewer(name = "Animal Type", palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_x_log10()+
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Age vs Length of Stay",
    x = "Age (Days)",
    y = "Length of Stay (days)",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

There does not appear to be a correlation.

## Time and intake

```{r message=F, warning=F}
intakes <- animalsYearEnd |>
  mutate(
    intake_type = if_else(intake_type %in% c("BOARDING", "VETERINARY", "TRANSFER", "RETURN"), "OTHER", intake_type)
         ) |>
  filter(!intake_type == "OTHER") |>
  filter(animal_type %in% c("CAT", "DOG")) |>
  mutate(
    year = year(intake_date_and_time),
    month = month(intake_date_and_time, label = T)
    ) |>
  group_by(year, month, animal_type, intake_type) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(month, animal_type, intake_type) |>
  summarise(mean_intakes = mean(count), .groups = "drop")

# plot
ggplot(intakes, aes(month, mean_intakes, colour = animal_type, group = animal_type)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.05) + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ intake_type, labeller = as_labeller(c("EUTH REQ" = "Euthanasia Request", 
                                                  "OWNER SUR" = "Owner Surrendered",
                                                  "CONFISCATE" = "Confiscated",
                                                  "STRAY" = "Stray"))) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  labs(
    x="",
    y="Intake Count",
    color="Animal Type",
    title = "Average Monthly Animal Intakes (2017-2026)",
    subtitle = "Mean intake volume by intake type",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center"
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
"Kitten season" is shown clearly

## Time and adoption

```{r}
# Mean adoptions by month
avg_adoptions <- animalsYearEnd |>
  filter(animal_type %in% c("CAT", "DOG")) |>
  filter(outcome_type == "ADOPTION") |>
  mutate(
    year = year(outcome_date_and_time),
    month = month(outcome_date_and_time, label = T)
    ) |>
  group_by(year, month, animal_type) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(month, animal_type) |>
  summarise(mean_adoptions = mean(count), .groups = "drop")
avg_adoptions <- head(avg_adoptions, 24)
```

## Plot average adoption frequency for each month

```{r}
ggplot(avg_adoptions, aes(x = month, y = mean_adoptions, fill = animal_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Animal Type", palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Monthly Adoptions by Animal Type (2017-2026)",
    x = "",
    y = "Adoption Count",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  )

```

```{r}
# Mean adpotions by day of week
avg_adoptions_week <- animalsYearEnd |>
  filter(animal_type %in% c("CAT", "DOG")) |>
  filter(outcome_type == "ADOPTION") |>
  mutate(
    date = as_date(outcome_date_and_time),
    day_of_week = wday(outcome_date_and_time, label = T)
    ) |>
  group_by(date, day_of_week, animal_type) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(day_of_week, animal_type) |>
  summarise(mean_adoptions = mean(count), .groups = "drop")
avg_adoptions_week <- head(avg_adoptions_week, 14) |>
  filter(day_of_week != "Wed") # shelter is closed on wednesday
```

## Plot mean adoption count by day of week

```{r}
ggplot(avg_adoptions_week, aes(x = day_of_week, y = mean_adoptions, fill = animal_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(name = "Animal Type", palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Adoptions by Day of Week (2017-2026)",
    x = "",
    y = "Adoption Count",
    caption = "Source: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center",
    subtitle = "Adoption Center is closed on Wednesdays"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  )
```


```{r}
adoptions_2025 <- animalsYearEnd |>
  filter(year(outcome_date_and_time) == 2025) |>
  filter(animal_type %in% c("CAT", "DOG")) |>
  filter(outcome_type == "ADOPTION") |>
  group_by(as.Date(outcome_date_and_time)) |>
  summarise(adoptions = n())
  
```

```{r}
# 2025 adoption event dates
event_dates <- as.Date(c("2025-03-14", "2025-05-10", "2025-08-23", "2025-12-20"))

ggplot(adoptions_2025, aes(x=`as.Date(outcome_date_and_time)`, y=adoptions)) + 
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = event_dates, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") + 
  labs(
    title = "Adoption Counts over Time (2025)",
    x = "",
    y = "Adoption Count",
    caption = "Sources: Montgomery County Animal Services & Adoption Center\n@MCASAC on Instagram",
    subtitle = "Lines indicate date of adoption promotion event"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```
